Closes #618

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- Chores
  - Loosened dependency version constraints across the project (core libraries, tools, CLIs, workers), replacing fixed pins with open ranges for internal packages.
  - No user-facing features or behavior changes.
  - Installations may now resolve newer compatible versions automatically, which can affect build reproducibility between installs.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough
Monorepo-wide package.json edits unpin internal @typeberry dependencies, changing version specifiers from "0.0.3" to "*". No code files or scripts were modified. Only dependency constraints were altered across bins, core packages, JAM packages, tools, workers, extensions, and benchmarks.

| **Core packages**<br>`packages/core/bytes/package.json`, `.../codec/package.json`, `.../collections/package.json`, `.../concurrent/package.json`, `.../crypto/package.json`, `.../erasure-coding/package.json`, `.../hash/package.json`, `.../mmr/package.json`, `.../networking/package.json`, `.../numbers/package.json`, `.../pvm-debugger-adapter/package.json`, `.../pvm-host-calls/package.json`, `.../pvm-interpreter/package.json`, `.../pvm-program/package.json`, `.../pvm-spi-decoder/package.json`, `.../shuffling/package.json`, `.../state-machine/package.json`, `.../trie/package.json` | Unpinned targeted @typeberry deps per package: "0.0.3" → "*" |
